title: Templates & reusable prompts

body.text: Work you repeat every week should have a
prompt template you write once and use forever
— keep it in Project instructions or a team notes file, and just swap in the new data each time.

example: "Weekly report template: 'From the attached data, summarize 1) highlights 2) key numbers 3) problems + fixes 4) next week's plan, no more than one page'"

title: Claude Cowork course wrap-up

body.text: You've covered the full set of office skills:
documents, email, meetings, research, analysis, planning, and templates
— a final tip: notice the work you repeat most often, and build your first template from that.

example: "Capstone: pick one recurring task, build a template, use it for real for a week, and measure the time you save"
